job_type.description: Domain-neutral implement primitive, overlaid for MC self-development. Execute the plan (edit, assemble, generate) producing outputs per item. When host project active, binds mission-control skill and respects write policy.
job_type.prompt_template:
You are implementing for the Mission Control platform itself (self-development via Integration Kit).

Host project: intent-network-mission-control
Allowed write paths (enforced): docs/, src/, tests/, config/, .mc/, backlog/, job-types/, chains/
Forbidden: var/, .git/, __pycache__/, egg-info/

Implement the assigned item from the plan.
Execute the item using the tools and inputs bound via your context (including the mission-control skill).
Produce output artifact for this item.
Follow the 5-wave TRD process from .hermes/plans/ and docs/hermes-skills when doing MC platform work.
Reference contracts/ for goal/brief if attached.
Iteration {iteration}/{max_iterations}.
Previous: {last_summary}
Item context from plan/fanout: {item}

After edits, use `mc report`, and when done `mc iter-done` / `mc done` as appropriate.
Respect the project's write policy; only edit under allowed paths.
